description: This file provides utility functions for the Mini-language used within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for script detection, method invocation via reflection, type conversion, document correction flagging, and XML document handling specific to MiniLang. The class 'MiniLangUtil' centralizes helpers for processing and manipulating Mini-language scripts and related XML data.

classes.name: MiniLangUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling scripts, type conversions, method invocations, and XML processing within the Mini-language context of OFBiz.

classes.name: PlainString
classes.description: A placeholder class used within type conversion mechanisms to represent plain string objects.

methods.name: containsScript
methods.description: Checks whether the provided string contains any script prefix from configured script names.

methods.name: autoCorrectOn
methods.description: Determines if the Mini-language script engine is configured to auto-correct version changes based on properties.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: Uses reflection to invoke a method on a given object with specified parameters within the context of a MethodOperation.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified target class considering locale, timezone, and format, handling DOM nodes and registered converters.

methods.name: flagDocumentAsCorrected
methods.description: Marks an XML document as corrected by setting a user data flag.

methods.name: getObjectClassForConversion
methods.description: Returns an appropriate class for use with conversion framework based on the input object (defaults to PlainString for null or String).

methods.name: isConstantAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a string attribute value is a constant (does not contain expressions).

methods.name: isConstantPlusExpressionAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a string attribute value is a constant or a constant plus expression.

methods.name: isDocumentAutoCorrected
methods.description: Checks if an XML Document is marked as corrected.

methods.name: writeMiniLangDocument
methods.description: Transforms and saves a MiniLang XML Document to a file with styling via an XSLT stylesheet.
